Pathophysiology
Hashimoto’s thyroiditis is an autoimmune disorder in which the 
immune system attacks and destroys the thyroid gland. It is the 
most common form of hypothyroidism. The enlarged, chroni-
cally inflamed thyroid gland becomes nonfunctional, with reac-
tive parts of the gland deteriorating after several years. Thyroid 
autoantibodies indicate the body’s immune system is attacking 
itself and whether an autoimmune thyroid condition is present, 
be it hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism. Epstein-Barr virus 
(EBV) has been implicated as a critical etiopathogenic factor in 
autoimmune thyroid disease. Janeg
